title: Vassiliko Cement seeks approval for share buyback
summary: Vassiliko Cement seeks approval for share buyback
body_markdown: **Cyprus:** Vassiliko Cement will hold an extraordinary general meeting in which it will seek approval for a share buyback on 29 October 2026. The Cyprus Mail newspaper has reported that the proposed buyback involves the purchase of up to 10% of issued share capital and would proceed over a period of 12 months.
